scripts.test: CI=true dotenvx run -- turbo run test:once --concurrency=2
scripts.test:semver: CI=true dotenvx run -- turbo run test:semver
scripts.tonnage:build: pnpm --filter treetrunks... --filter varmint... --filter tsdoc.json... --filter venerate... run build
scripts.tonnage:check: pnpm tonnage:build && pnpm dlx tonnage@0.1.1 check packages/treetrunks/tonnage.config.mjs && pnpm dlx tonnage@0.1.1 check packages/varmint/tonnage.config.mjs && pnpm dlx tonnage@0.1.1 check packages/tsdoc.json/tonnage.config.mjs && pnpm dlx tonnage@0.1.1 check packages/venerate/tonnage.config.mjs
scripts.tonnage:write: pnpm tonnage:build && pnpm dlx tonnage@0.1.1 write packages/treetrunks/tonnage.config.mjs && pnpm dlx tonnage@0.1.1 write packages/varmint/tonnage.config.mjs && pnpm dlx tonnage@0.1.1 write packages/tsdoc.json/tonnage.config.mjs && pnpm dlx tonnage@0.1.1 write packages/venerate/tonnage.config.mjs
scripts.nuke: find . -name 'node_modules' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && find . -name 'dist' -type d -prune -exec rm -rf '{}' + && rm pnpm-lock.yaml
